_comment: Change-narration corpus: positives are lifecycle intents (commit text, branches, PR bodies, CI triage, merge gates, release notes); negatives are sibling domains — code quality (coding-principles), repo health (oss-repository-conventions), markdown stewardship (docs-steward).
positive: write the commit text for my staged work
I'm about to commit this staged work — draft it in imperative mood
propose branch naming and worktree setup for this new work
clean up my branch history before I request review
is the PR text in sync with the diff after my latest commits?
opening a PR for this branch — write its description with issue linking
amending the last commit's text without changing the staged diff
check merge readiness on this PR — CI status and review thread resolution
preparing a release — draft the notes from the commit log
my commit subjects look inconsistent — review the branch against conventional commits
triage this PR's CI failure and the status checks
validate trailer placement in the commit text before I push
negative: review this diff for bugs and code quality issues
refactor the parser module so it reads better
add a license and contributing guide to this repository
score this repo's community health against best practice
audit the markdown docs for formatting drift
lint the frontmatter in our documentation tree
set up release-please automation for this repo
implement retry logic in the HTTP client
what health files is this repository missing?
fix the flaky unit test in the auth suite
harden the repo's dependency supply chain and CI
